purpose: Regress general tier-3 Soldier TrainingTech semantics after UnityDataTool direct-JSON migration. SP-specific description semantics remain reserved for stage 4-4.

policy.primaryPath: Among linked techs, the soldier-specific path is the unique 10-level TechLevelupInfoList whose TrainingTechLevelInfo.SoldierSkillLevelup sequence is exactly 1..10.
policy.getSoldierTechId: Validation metadata only; it is not the authoritative TrainingTech JOIN.
policy.levelOrder: TechLevelupInfoList order defines sequenceLevel; SoldierSkillLevelup is preserved independently and validates the soldier-skill Lv1..10 path.
policy.costs: Preserve LevelupGoldCost and LevelupMaterialsCost per level; Lv5/Lv10 totals are derived from those exact level records.
policy.spBoundary: SpSoidlierDescription is not asserted in 4-3 and is validated with SP-specific semantics in 4-4.

completion: All 129 general tier-3 TrainingTech profiles reproduce the pre-4-1 semantics from current direct JSON with unique Lv1-10 paths, intact descriptions and exact per-level-derived Lv5/Lv10 costs.
